title: 第111章 天门开，仙秦何在？
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

异变再生！

原本已经恢复了平静的天空，再一次毫无征兆地亮了起来。

这一次，不再是之前那种撕裂空间的黑暗裂缝，也不是杨戬降临时那种金光万丈的压迫感。

而是一种……无比恢弘，无比庄严，无比神圣的金色光芒。

这光芒从九天之上洒落，如同金色的瀑布，将整个天空都染成了一片灿烂的金色。

伴随着光芒的，还有阵阵仙音。

那声音仿佛来自大道的源头，空灵，缥缈，却又清晰地传入每一个人的耳中。有仙女在云端撒花，有天神在擂鼓，有无数的生灵在齐声歌唱。

在这仙音和神光之中，一道巨大无比的门户，正在天空的最高处缓缓地凝聚成形。

那是一座由纯粹的光芒和法则构成的门户。

门楣高耸，雕刻着日月星辰，山川万物。两根门柱如同擎天之柱，上面盘绕着栩栩如生的神龙与凤凰。

这道门，比起顾长青之前随手划开的那道“仙界之门”，不知道要宏伟多少倍，庄严多少倍！

一种来自血脉深处，来自灵魂本源的敬畏感，不受控制地从所有看到这扇门的人心中涌起。

仿佛这扇门背后，就是一切的起源，一切的归宿。

“这……这又是什么？”

刚刚站起来的李寒山等人，再一次被这突如其来的变故给搞懵了。

他们呆呆地抬着头，看着那扇正在缓缓洞开的金色门户，大脑一片空白。

难道是……天庭的主力来了？

杨戬回去搬救兵了？

可这气势，跟刚才杨戬那副气急败坏的样子完全不一样啊！

这更像是一种……正式的，带着无上威仪的……降临！

就在所有人都被这扇突然出现的“天界之门”所震撼，心中惴惴不安的时候。

顾长青的脸上，却第一次露出了若有所思的表情。

他看着那扇门，一段尘封已久的记忆，如同水底的气泡，缓缓地浮上了心头。

那是一个穿着黑色龙袍，眼神比星辰还要明亮的男人。

以及，一个跨越了两千年的约定。

“嬴政……”

顾长青轻声念出了这个名字。

“你……真的做到了？”

他心中想着，不知道那个约好了要去仙界建立仙秦运朝的始皇帝，现在怎么样了。

而就在这时，那扇宏伟的金色门户，终于彻底洞开！

金色的天界之门彻底洞开。

门内不再是深邃的星空，而是一片云雾缭绕的仙境。

仙音袅袅，仙气氤氲。

隐约可见白玉铺成的地面，黄金铸就的宫殿。有身穿七彩羽衣的仙女在云端之上翩翩起舞，手中的绸带划出优美的弧线。有身披银甲的天兵手持长戟，在南天门前肃穆而立。

这景象，和神话传说中描绘的天庭，一模一样。

“这……这是真正的天庭？”

“杨戬真的把玉皇大帝给叫来了？”

李寒山和云逍等人脸色发白，刚刚才放下去的心，瞬间又提到了嗓子眼。

他们不怕打架，甚至渴望打架。

但他们怕这种完全不在一个量级上的碾压。

刚才一个杨戬的法身，就压得他们喘不过气来。现在整个天庭摆开阵仗，这还怎么打？

祖师虽然强，可他能一个人对抗整个天庭吗？

“不对！”

就在众人心惊胆战的时候，龙虎山的老天师却突然开口，他的声音带着一丝极度的困惑。

“你们看，这天门的气息……虽然宏大，却没有杀意！”

“非但没有杀意，反而……反而像是一种……迎接的礼仪？”

经他这么一提醒，众人也反应了过来。

这天门虽然威势惊人，但给人的感觉却和杨戬降临时那种高高在上、充满审判意味的气息完全不同。

这更像是一个大国在迎接最尊贵的客人时，摆出的最高规格的仪仗。

是欢迎，不是宣战。

可……欢迎谁？

难道天庭是来欢迎祖师的？

开什么玩笑！

祖师刚刚才把他们的先锋大将杨戬打得屁滚尿流，还公然说要跟他们算三千年前的旧账。

天庭不派兵来剿灭就不错了，怎么可能还摆出这么大的阵仗来欢迎？

所有人都想不通，只能将疑惑的目光投向了场中唯一镇定自若的那个人。

顾长青。

他依旧悬浮在半空中，只是抬着头，静静地看着那扇宏伟的天门，眼神里带着一丝连他自己都没察觉到的……怀念。

“嬴政……”

他的脑海里，那个穿着黑色龙袍的男人的身影越来越清晰。

“先生，这天地，困住了朕。这神佛，压在了朕的头顶。朕不服！”

“朕要这天，再遮不住朕的眼。要这地，再埋不了朕的心。要这漫天神佛，都烟消云海外！”

“朕要建立一个前所未有的运朝，以国为舟，以民为桨，载着我华夏万民，冲出这片天地，去看看那更高的风景！”

“先生，你可愿为朕之国师，助朕一臂之力？”

顾长青还记得自己当时听到这番话时的心情。

他已经活了太久，见过太多的帝王将相。

那些人，求的无非是江山永固，个人长生。

这是他第一次见到，一个凡人帝王，有着如此狂妄，却又如此宏伟的野心。

他不是为了自己，而是为了整个“华夏”。

于是，他答应了。

他成为了大秦的国师。

他没有直接赐予嬴政力量，而是将长青仙宗的一些基础法门，一些关于天地法则的认知，教给了他。

他想看看，这个有趣的凡人，能走到哪一步。

而嬴政也没有让他失望。

他以举国之力，铸十二金人，镇压华夏气运。他焚书坑儒，烧的不是百家经典，而是那些神佛留在人间的道统传承，坑杀的不是无辜儒生，而是那些替神佛蛊惑人心的方士神棍。

他做的一切，都是为了摆脱神佛对人间的控制，将人道气运彻底凝聚在自己手中。

最后的约定是，嬴政以假死脱身，带着他最精锐的士卒，以及三千童男童女作为火种，乘坐以整个大秦国运打造的“蜃楼”，破开天门，前往天界，为他打下一片基业。

而顾长青自己，则留在人间，继续沉睡，等待一个契机。

一个足以让他打破这方世界“下界不可成仙”铁律的契机。

如今，顾长青已经醒来，并且以绝对的力量，撕开了天规的一角。

那么，嬴政呢？

他在天界，是否也遵守了当年的约定？

他建立的那个“仙秦运朝”，现在又是什么样子？

Mutations reborn!

The sky, which had returned to calm, once again lit up without warning.

This time, it was no longer the dark cracks that tore apart the space before, nor was it the oppressive feeling of golden light when Yang Jian arrived.

Rather, it is a kind of... extremely magnificent, extremely solemn, and extremely sacred golden light.

This light fell from the sky like a golden waterfall, dyeing the entire sky a brilliant golden color.

Along with the light, there are bursts of fairy sounds.

The sound seemed to come from the source of the avenue. It was ethereal and ethereal, but it passed into everyone's ears clearly.There are fairies scattering flowers in the clouds, gods beating drums, and countless creatures singing in unison.

In this fairy sound and divine light, a huge portal is slowly condensing into shape at the highest point in the sky.

It was a portal composed of pure light and law.

The lintel is high and carved with images of the sun, moon, stars, mountains and rivers.The two door pillars are like the pillars of the sky, with lifelike dragons and phoenixes coiled above them.

This door, compared to the "Gate to Immortal World" that Gu Changqing opened casually before, I don't know how many times more grand and solemn!

A sense of awe that comes from the depths of the blood and the origin of the soul surges uncontrollably from the hearts of everyone who sees this door.

It seems that behind this door is the origin and destination of everything.

"This...what is this?"

Li Hanshan and others, who had just stood up, were once again confused by this sudden change.

They raised their heads blankly, looking at the golden door that was slowly opening, their minds going blank.

Could it be that...the main force from Heaven is here?

Did Yang Jian go back to bring in reinforcements?

But this momentum is completely different from Yang Jian's furious look just now!

This is more like a...formal arrival with supreme majesty!

Just when everyone was shocked by the sudden appearance of the "Gate to Heaven" and felt uneasy in their hearts.

Gu Changqing's face showed a thoughtful expression for the first time.

He looked at the door, and a memory that had been buried for a long time slowly came to his mind like bubbles under the water.

It was a man wearing a black dragon robe, with eyes brighter than the stars.

And, an agreement that spans two thousand years.

"Ying Zheng..."

Gu Changqing read the name softly.

"You...really did it?"

He was thinking in his heart, wondering what was happening now with the First Emperor, who had made an appointment to go to the immortal world to establish the Immortal Qin Yun Dynasty.

And at this moment, the magnificent golden door finally opened completely!

The golden door to heaven is completely opened.

Inside the door is no longer the deep starry sky, but a fairyland shrouded in clouds and mist.

The fairy sound is curling up, and the fairy spirit is dense.

The ground paved with white jade and the palace made of gold can be vaguely seen.There are fairies wearing colorful feathers dancing above the clouds, the ribbons in their hands drawing graceful arcs.There are heavenly soldiers wearing silver armor holding halberds, standing solemnly in front of the Nantian Gate.

This scene is exactly the same as the heaven described in myths and legends.

"This...is this the real heaven?"

"Did Yang Jian really call the Jade Emperor?"

Li Hanshan, Yun Xiao and others turned pale, and their hearts that had just been relieved suddenly rose to their throats again.

They are not afraid of fighting, and even eager to fight.

But they are afraid of this kind of crushing that is not on the same level at all.

Just now, Yang Jian's body was so heavy that they couldn't breathe.Now that the entire heaven is engaged in battle, how can we fight?

Although the Patriarch is strong, can he fight against the entire heaven alone?

"No!"

Just when everyone was frightened, the Heavenly Master of Longhu Mountain suddenly spoke, his voice carrying a hint of extreme confusion.

"Look, the aura of this Tianmen... although it is grand, it does not have murderous intent!"

"Not only is there no murderous intent, but... it's like a... welcome etiquette?"

After his reminder, everyone also reacted.

Although the power of this Tianmen is astonishing, the feeling it gives people is completely different from the aura of superiority and judgment when Yang Jian arrived.

This is more like the highest standard of honor a great country puts on when welcoming its most distinguished guests.

It's a welcome, not a declaration of war.

But... who is welcome?

Could it be that Heaven is here to welcome the Patriarch?

What a joke!

The Patriarch had just beaten the shit out of their pioneer general Yang Jian, and openly said that he wanted to settle old scores with them from three thousand years ago.

It would be nice if the Heavenly Court didn't send troops to exterminate them. How could they put up such a big formation to welcome them?

Everyone couldn't figure it out and could only cast their doubtful eyes on the only calm person in the field.

Gu Changqing.

He was still suspended in mid-air, just raising his head and looking at the majestic heavenly gate quietly, with a trace of... nostalgia in his eyes that even he himself was not aware of.

"Ying Zheng..."

In his mind, the figure of the man in black dragon robe became clearer and clearer.

"Sir, this world has trapped me. These gods and Buddhas are pressing on my head. I don't accept it!"

"I want this sky, no longer able to cover my eyes. I want this land, no longer able to bury my heart. I want all the gods and Buddhas in the sky to vanish into thin air!"

"I want to build an unprecedented destiny dynasty, using the country as a boat and the people as oars, carrying all the Chinese people out of this world to see the higher scenery!"

"Sir, are you willing to be my national teacher and help me?"

Gu Changqing still remembers his mood when he heard these words.

He has lived for too long and has seen too many emperors and generals.

What those people want is nothing more than eternal stability of the country and personal immortality.

This was the first time he had seen a mortal emperor with such arrogant yet magnificent ambitions.

He is not doing it for himself, but for the whole "China".

So, he agreed.

He became the national advisor of Great Qin.

He did not directly give Ying Zheng power, but taught him some basic techniques of the Evergreen Immortal Sect and some understanding of the laws of heaven and earth.

He wanted to see how far this interesting mortal could go.

And Ying Zheng did not disappoint him.

He used the power of the whole country to cast twelve golden men to suppress China's destiny.He burned books to trap Confucians, not the classics of hundreds of schools of thought, but the Taoist traditions left by the gods and Buddhas in the human world. What he burned was not the innocent Confucian scholars, but the alchemists and magic sticks who deceived people on behalf of the gods and Buddhas.

Everything he did was to get rid of the control of gods and Buddhas on the human world and completely condense the fate of humanity into his own hands.

The final agreement was that Ying Zheng faked his death to escape, took his most elite soldiers, and three thousand boys and girls as fire, took a "mirage" built with the entire Great Qin national destiny, broke through the gate of heaven, went to the heaven, and laid a foundation for him.

Gu Changqing himself stayed in the human world, continuing to sleep, waiting for an opportunity.

An opportunity that is enough for him to break the iron law of this world that "you cannot become an immortal in the lower realms".

Now, Gu Changqing has woken up and used absolute power to tear apart a corner of the heavenly rules.

So, what about Ying Zheng?

Did he abide by the agreement he made back then in heaven?

What does the "Immortal Qin Dynasty" he established look like now?
